The live server (already running on 8640) returned `{"suggestions":[]}` — the endpoint is live and working. The memory recall context confirms there was no previous suggestions REST endpoint, so this is a clean addition.

Here's a summary of everything implemented:

---

## What was added to `pty-server.ts` (548 lines, under 800 limit)

### 1. `Suggestion` interface + in-memory store
```
Map<string, Suggestion>  →  suggestionsStore
```
Each entry holds: `id`, `text`, `source`, `confidence`, `status` (`pending | accepted | rejected`), `agentId`, `query`, `createdAt`.

### 2. Auto-creation from `agent_finding`
`broadcastActivity()` now calls `autoCreateSuggestion()` whenever it broadcasts an `agent_finding` event. Only events with **`confidence > 0.5`** create a suggestion — lower-confidence findings are silently dropped. The suggestion `text` is derived from the first item in the `items` array (or a fallback string).

### 3. Three new REST endpoints

| Method | Path | Behaviour |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `GET` | `/api/suggestions` | Returns `{ suggestions: Suggestion[] }` (empty array if none yet) |
| `POST` | `/api/suggestions/:id/accept` | Marks `status = "accepted"`; POSTs to `${MEMORY_URL}/learn` with `ttlMs = 86400000` (24 h); tolerates memory being offline |
| `POST` | `/api/suggestions/:id/reject` | Marks `status = "rejected"` |

### DoD verification
```
{"suggestions":[]}          ← .suggestions is [] (not null) ✅
TypeScript: no errors in pty-server.ts ✅
Line count: 548 / 800 ✅
```
